narrative: Teams can now self-serve GitHub operations — create repos, update content settings, manage memberships, and record policy exceptions — without raising a PR on the control repo. The policy engine enforces per-team rules at every entry point, and the plan engine tracks all three self-serve resource types (create/unchanged/delete), closing the gap that cost 8 gate runs in I2.
